decisions.reason: Height-adjustable executive desks extend the firm's established office line, and post-2020 demand for flexible workplaces likely kept results at or above aspiration, so there is little reason to search for alternatives.
A chair family close to the core offer uses existing craftsmanship and sales channels, giving stable performance that meets aspirations at low carrying cost.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with uncertain results, but the firm is hiring and doing its own R&D, which signals enough slack to carry them for now.
The soft sofa by the renowned designer studio EOOS was featured prominently in 2019 and fits the firm's living-space core, so it likely satisfies aspirations.
The high standing table complements the conference and lounge offer close to the core business and needs few extra resources, so a shortfall large enough to trigger search is unlikely.

The rug collection is distant from the firm's established offer, so it is the product most likely to fall short of aspirations and the first target when problemistic search reallocates resources to the core.
